fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Two Lineages, Two Kinds Of Cultivation", "body": "English says he trained under two lineages and has just become a disciple under a third, and he untangles what the modern world lumps together as qigong, neigong and neidan. The first branch, which he calls jing jin or muscle tendon changing neigong, works with acquired or post birth chi and begins by condensing energy in the lower abdomen through reverse abdominal breathing, a method he credits to a Buddhist kung fu family and to Shaolin disciple Chief Misan and Grandmaster Golin. The second branch, spirit cultivation, he contends was deliberately kept out of books, leaving Western readers only the foundational jing, chi and shen material."}, {"title": "The Dantian, The Girdle Vessel And The Iron Body", "body": "English calls the lower dantian a bioelectric battery sitting in the center of the abdomen, and describes it as level one of the game. He points to the girdle vessel, a horizontal meridian circling the waist, and to the huang, the Chinese name for the fascia and the empty spaces between the organs, as what the chi mobilizes through, citing the old saying about separating the flesh from the bone. Later he argues a microcosmic orbit should be thick, shoulder to shoulder, and recalls Grandmaster Golin breaking bricks with his head as iron body attainment. Chance Garton compares notes as a Wu family qigong practitioner."}, {"title": "Yin Shen, Yang Shen And Spiritual Immortality", "body": "English describes the yin shen as the chi or astral body that most people never gather, dispersed like a cloud around the lower dantian and, in his account, unable to hold itself together after death without anchoring back into a human body. Yang shen training, he says, condenses and strengthens it until it takes the form of an embryo that rises through the crown, which he reads as the meaning behind the Buddha on the lotus. He states he has been through the process himself and is instructed to take it out only once weekly, twenty to thirty minutes, overseen by the grandmaster."}, {"title": "Embryonic Breathing And The Spiritual Pregnancy", "body": "English argues the belly on the Buddha is not allegory but a spiritual pregnancy available to men and women alike, formed from a person's own innate chi rather than another's seed, and he references the book Chi Kung Meditation: Embryonic Breathing on dual cultivation. He describes internal embryonic breathing as a respiration that does not run on inhale and exhale through the nose and mouth, the way one breathed in the womb, and contends that all breath work, yoga and neigong were ultimately aimed at activating it. Garton likens the role to becoming a placenta for your own next body."}, {"title": "Virtue, Religion And The Game Of Immortality", "body": "English frames what he calls a consciousness accretion process, distinct from animal death, and insists the energy work is worthless without a code of conduct, arguing that lust, anger and envy consume what has been gathered and that the church's deadly sins were really the law of the energy field. He describes his lineage's heavenly essence qigong as holographic transmissions from Grandmaster Zang, likens the Dao to Wi-Fi with a master as the signal booster, and says these teachings reached the West only after the Chinese Communist Party's crackdown. He closes on stadium spectators who know everything and never play."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Mark English, aka Eso El, joins InnerVerse to talk about his practice and teachings with Neigong techniques. Tune in to discover the chi condensing power of the dantien, creating the out-of-body consciousness vehicle, retaining full individuated memory and awareness after death, becoming a placenta to your next body, psychic & energetic abilities through chi cultivation, and the path to become a player instead of spectator in the game of immortality.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension we discuss the three types of chi, ancient Egyptians and original Buddhism as keepers of these chi techniques, the economy of virtue on the soul's journey through lives, the path of Gnosis, germs and generative powers, the origin and fall of humanity, and the periodical renovation of the matrix. All that and much more…

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "A Container For Your Own Consciousness", "body": "Chance opens the second hour with a realization he had long circled: the whole point of meditation is holding awareness outside the body indefinitely, a goal that once discouraged him until Mark's idea of cultivating a container made it click. He compares it to building an online store or website for his art, a body where the energy can accumulate instead of dispersing into the ether, only here the thing being gestated is yourself. Mark answers that this vehicle is also called the primordium, the solar body of the ascended masters, and insists it is within reach from home, no trip to China required."}, {"title": "Wax, Flame And Light", "body": "Mark lays out jing, qi and shen as one energy at three stages. Jing is the sexual essence and body fluids, converted into qi only through abstinence while sinking the breath and producing heat in the dantian, while shen is the mind and neutral observer, seated at the pineal gland he calls the garage for the subtle body. In his candle image, jing is the wax, qi the fire, and shen the light the whole candle exists to make. He ranks kundalini and yang qi among the lowest yet hardest levels, and says real kundalini is not a painful jolt up the spine but a gentle warmth summoned at will."}, {"title": "Virtue Is A Law Of The Energy Field", "body": "Mark argues mainstream Buddhism misread egolessness: it never meant having no emotion, only never letting anger or lust run so extreme that they consume the gathered energy, and enlightenment as mere mental emptiness wastes the point of having a body as a container. Chance adds that whatever we energize gets amplified, delusions included, and recalls finding a vow shaped like a shackle in a tuning client's field. Mark treats the appreciation listeners feel as a gong transmission that builds virtue, like money increasing itself in economics, and says people should take more pride in their code of conduct than in ancestry or titles."}, {"title": "Reborn Into A Second Body", "body": "For Mark, being born again is literal: the moment the Yang Shen emerges is a second birth and a new birthday, and nursing it makes you accountable the way Chance says new parents suddenly get their lives together. Mark says he would have been Christian if the church had kept the embryo techniques, and that a Shifu was always meant to prepare students for everlasting life, while Chance calls Christianity a broken adaptation of Buddhism. Mark describes practicing at least two hours every morning, recommends William Bodri's Arhat Yoga on the bodies beyond Yang Shen, and explains the Buddha's five eyes as the sight of his other bodies."}, {"title": "Germs, Curiosity And The Rebuilt Matrix", "body": "Mark cites Harold Percival's view that the germ cell is the immortal part of us, and Chance reads the modern fear of germs as a war on the generative force itself. Mark says that fear disperses the Yang Shen, and that fallen races chase immortality vampirically because their damaged genetics bar them from consciousness accretion. His origin story holds that curiosity, not evil, first birthed distortion in the heavenly realms. Chance sees black screens absorbing human attention and a recurring playbook for trapping souls, reading the architect in The Matrix Reloaded as proof the system must keep offering a choice, and Mark answers that death should never be a mystery."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I've had inklings of this realization before that the whole point of the practice is to be able to maintain your awareness outside of the body indefinitely.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The jing is the substance, the wax. The fire is the qi, the heat. The light that's produced from the wax and fire is shen.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "What's the purpose of you having a body in a container to then go back to obliterate it into oneness again?", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When we appreciate each other, we are actually adding to their sort of spiritual bank account in the metaphor.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "What you should be more proud of is your code of conduct. Now, how is your mind? How is your peace? How do you treat others? How is your virtue, and what is your knowledge?", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Virtue isn't just give $1 to the homeless person or pretend to be kind. It's a law of the energy field because your energy is more gathered, condensed, and you have a container.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The real germ is your generative force, and you definitely don't want to go to war against that.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "What birthed distortion was not evil. Evil didn't birth distortion and suffering. What birthed what we call evil is curiosity.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Your light is going into this absorptive black screen, regardless of how lit up it is.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm so passionate about sharing this knowledge so that people know that death is not a mystery.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "The body has a bioelectric battery. It's centered directly in the center of the abdomen called the lower dantian.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The spiritual immortality is kind of like being able to keep your memory and sense of individuated self after the physical body is deceased.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Within the caterpillar is a butterfly, right? So within the human being is that yin shen that can be coalesced, gathered, condensed, and strengthened.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The placenta while you're in the womb is literally a living spiritual being that is sharing the identical DNA with you.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Human beings was meant to go through what's called a consciousness accretion process, not the same process of death like the animal kingdom.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This is why meditation is so important, I think, because essentially what we're talking about is the ability to maintain your attention indefinitely, without losing track, without zoning out.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "And it's the same for the game of immortality, enlightenment. Not much human beings are actually playing this cultivation game.", "author": "Mark English", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cea7e1b1-8e90-40fa-b2b7-1f2b6cc7b534/MARK-ENGLISH.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If there was a meaning to this life, it would be to figure out how to extend that life forward into the future.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
